title_en: A Living Map in the Rain
note_en: 不但没有 A，反而 B means "not only didn't A, but on the contrary B," reporting the opposite of the expected reaction. In the text: 老陈不但没有生气，反而把原来三个小时的讲解压成了一个小时的精华版 "far from getting angry, Lao Chen squeezed the three-hour tour into a one-hour highlights version." After 不但 you'd normally expect 而且 adding more in the same direction; 反而 flips it, and the negative 没有 comes right after 不但.
